constant_signal_audit.method: read-only selected-signal variance/constant audit; no corrcoef/graph/Q calculation

limitations: fixed 120-row panel, no population effect inference
no independent Louvain recalculation in closure audit
no phase-separated H3 timing or source-read byte telemetry
zero correlations for undefined corrcoef are inherited modeling choices

resource.memory_semantics: sampled RSS, not process-group true peak or hard limit
resource.storage_semantics: run_directory_bytes is Watchdog exit sample including its emergency scratch reserve; terminal_all_file_bytes is the closed-directory file-byte sum after reserve cleanup

historical_environment_gaps: PS-A environment.txt does not record the SciPy version used by its MST builder
PS-A environment.txt does not record h5py or the HDF5 library version
